title: Paperclip
description: Agent runs, startup and first-token latency, turns and tools, workspace sync, controller, budget, HTTP and database performance for Paperclip, derived from its OpenTelemetry traces.

panels.title: Failed runs
panels.description: Runs that ended in an error status in the range: task.execution_attempt (every adapter) plus task.provider_session (native runner). A healthy setup has none, so any failure is flagged.

panels.title: Run failure rate vs usual
panels.description: Share of runs that failed now (dashboard range) divided by the same figure over your last 7d: 1.0x = as usual. Orange from 1.5x, red from 2.5x.

targets.expr: ((((round(sum(increase(traces_spanmetrics_calls_total{service=~"$service",span_name=~"task\\.(execution_attempt|provider_session)",status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"}[$__range]))) or vector(0)) + 1) / ((round(sum(increase(traces_spanmetrics_calls_total{service=~"$service",span_name="task.execution_attempt"}[$__range]))) or vector(0)) + 2)) / (((round(sum(increase(traces_spanmetrics_calls_total{service=~"$service",span_name=~"task\\.(execution_attempt|provider_session)",status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"}[7d]))) or vector(0)) + 1) / ((round(sum(increase(traces_spanmetrics_calls_total{service=~"$service",span_name="task.execution_attempt"}[7d]))) or vector(0)) + 2))) or vector(-1)

panels.title: API server errors
panels.description: HTTP server spans with an error status (5xx) in the range. A healthy API has none.

panels.title: Controller errors
panels.description: Error spans from controller startup and recovery phases (controller.startup.*, controller.native_reconciliation). A phase that fails does not stop the server, but it means recovery work did not complete.

panels.title: Run duration vs usual
panels.description: Mean run (executor invocation) duration now (dashboard range) divided by the same figure over your last 7d: 1.0x = as usual. Orange from 1.5x, red from 2.5x. Means are used because span-metric percentiles stop at 16 s; percentiles are in the Runs row.

panels.title: Run configuration vs usual
panels.description: Mean time to prepare a run's configuration (skills, secrets, connectors, identity) now (dashboard range) divided by the same figure over your last 7d: 1.0x = as usual. Orange from 1.5x, red from 2.5x.

panels.title: Workspace preparation vs usual
panels.description: Mean workspace preparation time (source, provisioning, repository admission, environment) now (dashboard range) divided by the same figure over your last 7d: 1.0x = as usual. Orange from 1.5x, red from 2.5x.

panels.title: API latency vs usual
panels.description: Mean HTTP request duration now (dashboard range) divided by the same figure over your last 7d: 1.0x = as usual. Orange from 1.5x, red from 2.5x.

panels.title: Runs
panels.description: Executor invocations (task.execution_attempt spans) in the range, for every adapter.

panels.title: Run success rate
panels.description: Runs without an error status. A native-runner failure marks its task.provider_session span.

targets.expr: (1 - (round(sum(increase(traces_spanmetrics_calls_total{service=~"$service",span_name=~"task\\.(execution_attempt|provider_session)",status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"}[$__range]))) or vector(0)) / (round(sum(increase(traces_spanmetrics_calls_total{service=~"$service",span_name="task.execution_attempt"}[$__range]))) or vector(0))) or vector(-1)

panels.title: Agent time
panels.description: Total wall-clock time of all runs in the range (runs can overlap, so this can exceed the range).

panels.title: Avg run duration
panels.description: Mean run duration. Percentiles are in the Runs row.

panels.title: API requests
panels.description: HTTP server spans in the range (the board UI, agents and the API).

panels.title: Budget checks
panels.description: Budget admission evaluations in the range: one per run dispatch and per budgeted action.

panels.title: Run duration p95
panels.description: 95th percentile of run duration (TraceQL metrics; no 16 s cap).

panels.title: Configuration p95
panels.description: 95th percentile of run configuration time (skills, secrets, connectors, identity).

panels.title: API latency p95
panels.description: 95th percentile of HTTP server span duration.

panels.title: Native runner runs
panels.description: Runs through the native Paperclip Runner (task.provider_session). Zero when your agents use legacy adapters such as claude_local.

panels.title: Native run success rate
panels.description: Native runner runs without an error status.

targets.expr: (1 - (round(sum(increase(traces_spanmetrics_calls_total{service=~"$service",span_name="task.provider_session",status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"}[$__range]))) or vector(0)) / (round(sum(increase(traces_spanmetrics_calls_total{service=~"$service",span_name="task.provider_session"}[$__range]))) or vector(0))) or vector(-1)

panels.title: Tool success rate (native)
panels.description: Native control-plane tool executions without an error status.

targets.expr: (1 - (round(sum(increase(traces_spanmetrics_calls_total{service=~"$service",span_name="tool.execute",status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"}[$__range]))) or vector(0)) / (round(sum(increase(traces_spanmetrics_calls_total{service=~"$service",span_name="tool.execute"}[$__range]))) or vector(0))) or vector(-1)

panels.title: Runs and failures per hour
panels.description: Executor invocations per hour, and how many of them failed (error status on task.execution_attempt or task.provider_session).

panels.title: Run duration
panels.description: Duration of one executor invocation (admission reads, preparation, provider dispatch and inline settlement). Deferred work such as workspace finalization is separate. p95 is dashed.

panels.title: Concurrent runs (average)
panels.description: Average number of runs in flight (seconds of run time per second). Sudden growth means runs are queueing or getting longer.

panels.title: Recent runs (click a trace ID to open the waterfall)
Slowest runs
panels.description: Run ID is the first 12 hex characters of the SHA-256 of the run UUID, never the UUID itself.

panels.title: Failed runs
panels.description: Runs whose root span has an error status. Empty is good. Open the span ID to see which phase failed.

targets.query: { resource.service.name =~ "${service:regex}" && name =~ "task\\.(execution_attempt|provider_session)" && status = error } | select(span.paperclip.task.run.run_id, span.paperclip.task.run.outcome)

panels.title: Where run preparation time goes (avg)
panels.description: Mean duration of each top-level preparation phase (heartbeat.prepare.*). Phases run before the provider starts; workspace and configuration contain sub-steps, shown separately.

panels.title: Where configuration time goes (avg)
panels.description: Sub-steps of heartbeat.prepare.execution_configuration: skills, secrets, connectors, GitHub and agent identity. They are inside the configuration duration; do not add them to it.

panels.title: Where skills preparation goes (avg)
panels.description: Skill inventory, version read, materialization and verification (skills.*). These sit inside configuration_skills.

panels.title: Preparation over time (avg by phase)
panels.description: The five heaviest preparation phases per run, averaged per step. A growing layer is the phase that got slower.

panels.title: Preparation phase p95
panels.description: 95th percentile of the two phases that usually dominate preparation.

panels.title: Execution phases (avg)
panels.description: Usage startup, MCP handoff, dispatch admission, budget reservation, runtime and realtime dispatch (execution.*). Nested spans overlap their parents.

panels.title: Completion phases (avg)
panels.description: Run-log finalization, terminal persistence, accounting, liveness and continuation summaries (completion.*).

panels.title: Execution and completion over time (avg)
panels.description: How long the main post-dispatch phases took per step.

panels.title: Native runner: startup and first token
Time to first token
panels.description: Wait until the first deliverable text, measured from the accepted trigger (queueing, preparation, startup, provider latency and ingestion). p95 is dashed.

defaults.noValue: no native runner runs in this range

panels.title: Runner startup
panels.description: Runner session startup: transport, runtime staging and workspace sync, until the first durable turn.submitted event. p95 is dashed.

defaults.noValue: no native runner runs in this range

panels.title: Fresh and resumed sessions per hour
panels.description: runner.session.bootstrap = a new provider session; runner.session.resume = an exact recovered session. Resumes skip most startup work.

defaults.noValue: no native runner runs in this range

panels.title: Where startup time goes (avg)
panels.description: Mean duration per Runner startup phase. Nested phases overlap their parents (for example artifact preparation sits inside transport connect), so do not add the bars.

defaults.noValue: no native runner runs in this range

panels.title: Where native preparation time goes (avg)
panels.description: Mean duration per native preparation phase before the provider starts. heartbeat.queue is the wait before preparation begins.

defaults.noValue: no native runner runs in this range

panels.title: Native runner: agent turns and tools
Turn duration
panels.description: From turn.submitted to the provider terminal event. Includes model time and tool use. p95 is dashed.

defaults.noValue: no native runner runs in this range
no native runner runs in this range

panels.title: Turn latency to first activity (p95)
panels.description: submitted_to_started: time for the provider to accept the turn. time_to_first_agent_event: first meaningful provider activity (assistant or reasoning text, or a tool announcement), not a finished answer.

defaults.noValue: no native runner runs in this range

panels.title: Tool executions per 5 min by tool
panels.description: Native control-plane tool calls by their known semantic operation (anything else is 'other'). Counts per fixed 5-minute step; no arguments or call IDs are exported.

defaults.noValue: no native runner runs in this range

panels.title: Tool failures per 5 min by tool
panels.description: Tool executions that ended in an error status. Empty is good.

targets.query: { resource.service.name =~ "${service:regex}" && name = "tool.execute" && status = error } | count_over_time() by (span.paperclip.native.span.operation)

defaults.noValue: No tool failures in this range

panels.title: Tool execution p95 by tool
panels.description: Authorization plus execution inside the server authority, including HTTP request time.

defaults.noValue: no native runner runs in this range

panels.title: Tool request input streaming (p95)
panels.description: From a tool announcement to its last input update. Includes provider buffering and transport; not the exact end of model generation.

defaults.noValue: no native runner runs in this range

panels.title: Slow tool executions (over 1 s, slowest first)

defaults.noValue: no native runner runs in this range

panels.title: Turns by provider
panels.description: Agent turns by provider kind (for ACPX the underlying agent, such as claude or codex).

defaults.noValue: no native runner runs in this range

panels.title: Workspace environment
panels.description: Where each run's workspace was realized (paperclip.native.span.driver on environment.workspace.realize): local, or the sandbox provider.

defaults.noValue: no native runner runs in this range

panels.title: Runner transport
panels.description: How the controller reached the Runner (paperclip.native.span.mode on runner.transport.selected), for example local_loopback.

defaults.noValue: no native runner runs in this range

panels.title: Slowest workspace preparation steps (avg)
panels.description: Eight slowest heartbeat.prepare.workspace_* steps by mean duration. Steps are inside heartbeat.prepare.workspace; do not add them to it.

panels.title: Workspace data written per 5 min
panels.description: Bytes recorded by asset writes and verification (paperclip.execution.bytes), summed per 5 minutes.

panels.title: Repository checkout cache
panels.description: Outcome of the pristine repository-object cache lookup when a task checks out a repository: hit, miss, published, already_present, contended, capacity, budget, invalid, disabled or error. Empty for workspaces without a repository.

panels.title: Controller startup phases (slowest)
panels.description: Slowest controller phase per name in the range (tool reviews, gateway sessions, delivery workers, accounting, plugin workers, native recovery, ...). These are readiness phases, not agent runs. They are recorded at server start, so widen the range to include one.

panels.title: Controller span errors per hour
panels.description: Error spans from controller.* phases per hour. Empty is good.

defaults.noValue: No controller errors in this range

panels.title: Native reconciliation passes
panels.description: Duration of native finalization reconciliation passes. Only passes of one second or longer are recorded, so no data means every pass was fast.

panels.title: Budget operations per hour
panels.description: Budget admission, reservation, accounting, settlement, enforcement and cancellation spans (paperclip.budgets tracer).

panels.title: Budget accounting lock wait (p95)
panels.description: Time to acquire the company accounting lock. Rises under contention between concurrent runs of one company.

panels.title: Budget enforcement duration (avg)
panels.description: How long budget enforcement work took: delivery, scope evaluation and cancellation (budget.enforcement.*, budget.cancellation.*).

panels.title: HTTP requests per 5 min by method
panels.description: Server spans from the HTTP auto-instrumentation, by request method. Attribute names follow the stable OpenTelemetry semantic conventions.

panels.title: HTTP responses per 5 min by status
panels.description: Responses by HTTP status code. Anything 5xx also shows as an error span.

panels.title: Slowest API requests (over 250 ms, slowest first)
panels.description: The path is the request path as received, so it can contain task or agent IDs.

targets.query: { resource.service.name =~ "${service:regex}" && kind = server && duration > 250ms } | select(span.http.request.method, span.url.path, span.http.response.status_code)

panels.title: Task detail read phases (avg)
panels.description: GET /api/issues/:id phases (paperclip.issue-read tracer): lookup, authorization, ancestors, documents, blockers, and so on. Concurrent phases overlap.

panels.title: Slack receipt reactions per 5 min
panels.description: Eyes reactions acknowledging durable receipt of a Slack message: confirmed or failed. Failed attempts are not acknowledgement latency samples.

panels.title: Receipt delivery age (avg)
panels.description: Durable inbound receipt to provider confirmation. Excludes Slack-to-webhook transit and SDK parsing.

panels.title: Receipt queue time (avg)
panels.description: Action creation to transport.

panels.title: Busiest spans per minute
panels.description: The ten most frequent span names. Instrumentation spans (HTTP, authentication) usually dominate.

panels.title: Span errors per hour
panels.description: Error spans by name per hour; empty is good.

defaults.noValue: No span errors in this range

panels.title: Spans per minute
panels.description: Spans reaching Tempo from the selected instance(s). No data means Paperclip is not exporting: check OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT and the server log for a package diagnostic.

panels.title: Instances reporting
panels.description: Distinct service names (OTEL_SERVICE_NAME) with spans in the range.

panels.title: Spans per minute by instance
panels.description: Span ingest rate per service.
